name: KJ Battlegrounds
desc:
⚠️THIS GAME IS IN ALPHA EXPECT BUGS AND THINGS THAT DONT WORK⚠️

Train & fight others to be the strongest.

📱💻🎮 You can play on any device. (CONSOLE, PC, MOBILE)
⭐ Please consider liking and favoriting the game for more updates.

🖥️ Controls
G - ultimate mode
F - block
Q - dash
Q (while ragdolled) - ragdoll cancel/evasive
Double Tap W - run
Left Click - punch
B - emote wheel
